segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַבָּא עַל נַעֲרָה הַמְאוֹרָסָה אֵינוֹ חַיָּיב, עַד שֶׁתְּהֵא נַעֲרָה, בְּתוּלָה, מְאוֹרָסָה, וְהִיא בְּבֵית אָבִיהָ. בָּאוּ עָלֶיהָ שְׁנַיִם, הָרִאשׁוֹן בִּסְקִילָה וְהַשֵּׁנִי בְּחֶנֶק.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «One who engages in intercourse with a betrothed young woman is not liable» to be executed by stoning «unless she is a young woman,» i.e., neither a minor nor an adult; «a virgin; betrothed» but not yet married; «and she» lives «in her father’s home,» having yet to move in with her husband. If «two» men «engaged in intercourse with her, the first» is liable to be executed «by stoning, and the second» is liable to be executed «by strangulation.» The second man is executed in this manner in accordance with the halakha of one who engages in intercourse with a married or non-virgin betrothed woman, as she was no longer a virgin when he engaged in intercourse with her.
